column5: Benjamin Jensen, living in the Edgewater subdivision, said that 82 people had signed a petition that they gave to their Homeowners Association (HOA) to improve the parking in the Edgewater development, and they had done nothing about it. He said that there were only 32 visitor spots, and people have to pay $100 to get a parking spot for which there was a waiting list. He said that they had to park in the visitor parking spots on Christmas Eve so that family could park there later in the day.
